messages.author: 088e8a47a714e2a7
messages.subject: Disregard previous message Re gm.prcomp
parts:
I apologize for the previous message. I was able to fix the error myself. I'll note the issue here in case anyone else runs into this in the future...

When you use gm.prcomp, you must use $coords generated by the gpagen function. I had reformatted the $coords to a matrix before running gm.prcomp. While the gm.prcomp function runs, it does not generate the $shapes value.

Best, Karen

Yes, there is no way for gr,prcomp to receive a matrix and know that it should convert it to a 3D array of shape coordinates.

Cheers!
